design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, functional. The dashboard acts as a highly disciplined command center. Color exists only to guide action. Stark contrasts and tabular accuracy are prioritized over decorative elements. A rejection of the standard 'fintech dark mode' in favor of institutional, high-tier clarity.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Everything aligns to a strict box model.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Generous inner padding for structural elements (p-6, p-8) but tight padding for tabular data rows.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Rounded-none to max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain the brutalist, institutional feel.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data and labels. Center alignment ONLY for empty states or specialized visualizers.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders: flat background, 1px solid border-border/40, no soft shadows. For active states, border deepens to solid black.
surface_styles.headers: Solid White background with a hard 1px bottom border (#E5E5E5). No glassmorphism here, must feel rigid.
surface_styles.buttons: Primary: Solid black (#0A0A0A) background, white text, 0px border radius. Hover: slight lift and shadow. Secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid black border.

components_strategy.forms_inputs: Shadcn based. Customization: remove border radius, use 1px solid border (#E5E5E5). On focus: ring-1 ring-black, border-black.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. No vertical borders. 1px bottom border per row. Hover effect: bg-gray-50.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts). Color palette for charts: Signal Blue (#0055FF), Obsidian (#0A0A0A), and Mint/Red for up/down. Strict axis lines.
components_strategy.strategy_builder: React Flow with brutalist styling. Nodes have thick 2px borders, sharp corners. Connection lines are stark black with solid arrowheads.
components_strategy.modals: Slide-in panels (Sheets) preferred over centered Modals for a terminal-like feel. Backdrop: black/20, no blur.

motion.hover: Instant color swaps or crisp 0.15s transforms. No floating or bouncy animations.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, perfectly aligned with text baseline.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute all elements with rigorous structural discipline. Avoid soft, rounded, floating, or generic SaaS aesthetics.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for all major headings and numbers that need authoritative impact. Use IBM Plex Mono for all data grids, tables, and precise readouts.
Do NOT use card shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders (`border-gray-200` or `border-black/10`) for separation. Use a border-collapse grid approach where possible.
For the visual strategy builder (React Flow), apply the brutalist aesthetic: sharp nodes, thick connections, high contrast.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive components according to the E1 specifications.
Install `@phosphor-icons/react` for icons to match the dense, functional aesthetic.
Ensure charts use the strictly defined semantic colors (Signal Blue, Mint Green, Warning Red).
Use the provided image URLs for user avatars, broker logos, and placeholders. DO NOT use placeholder text or dummy image generators.
